title: Feature request: add option to view multiple temperature units
line: The weather widget can now also show the temperature in a second unit, in its tooltip and popup.
explanation: The weather widget had a single temperature unit setting, and the tooltip, popup and panel always formatted the temperature in that unit only, so people comparing weather with friends abroad had to convert it themselves. The change adds an "Also show in:" checkbox with a unit selector under Temperature in the Units settings page (off by default). When enabled, the tooltip shows e.g. "overcast 55°F (13°C)" and the popup shows the converted temperature under the large current temperature.

commits.message:
applets/weather: add option to also show temperature in a second unit

The temperature could only be shown in one unit, so people following the
weather with friends abroad had to convert it themselves. A new option in
the Units page shows it in a second unit too, in the tooltip and popup.

BUG: 523095

         let isTemperaturePresent = !!forecastControl.forecast.lastObservation?.temperature && !!forecastControl.forecast.metaData?.temperatureUnit;
